      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# CODEALPHA TASK 4\n",
        "# Disease Prediction from Medical Data\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "# Step 1: Import required libraries\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split\n",
        "from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, classification_report, confusion_matrix\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# Step 2: Load the dataset\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "url = \"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jbrownlee/Datasets/master/pima-indians-diabetes.data.csv\"\n",
        "\n",
        "columns = [\n",
        "    \"Pregnancies\",\n",
        "    \"Glucose\",\n",
        "    \"BloodPressure\",\n",
        "    \"SkinThickness\",\n",
        "    \"Insulin\",\n",
        "    \"BMI\",\n",
        "    \"DiabetesPedigreeFunction\",\n",
        "    \"Age\",\n",
        "    \"Outcome\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "data = pd.read_csv(url, names=columns)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Dataset loaded successfully!\")\n",
        "print(\"Shape of dataset:\", data.shape)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Display first 5 rows\n",
        "display(data.head())\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# Step 3: Check dataset information\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nDataset Information:\")\n",
        "print(data.info())\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nMissing Values:\")\n",
        "print(data.isnull().sum())\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# Step 4: Separate input and output\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "X = data.drop(\"Outcome\", axis=1)\n",
        "y = data[\"Outcome\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# Step 5: Split data into training and testing sets\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(\n",
        "    X,\n",
        "    y,\n",
        "    test_size=0.20,\n",
        "    random_state=42,\n",
        "    stratify=y\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nTraining samples:\", X_train.shape[0])\n",
        "print(\"Testing samples:\", X_test.shape[0])\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# Step 6: Create Machine Learning model\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "model = RandomForestClassifier(\n",
        "    n_estimators=100,\n",
        "    random_state=42\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Train the model\n",
        "model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nModel training completed!\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# Step 7: Make predictions\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "y_pred = model.predict(X_test)\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# Step 8: Evaluate the model\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nModel Accuracy:\")\n",
        "print(f\"{accuracy * 100:.2f}%\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nClassification Report:\")\n",
        "print(classification_report(y_test, y_pred))\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# Step 9: Confusion Matrix\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "cm = confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nConfusion Matrix:\")\n",
        "print(cm)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(6, 5))\n",
        "plt.imshow(cm)\n",
        "plt.title(\"Confusion Matrix - Diabetes Prediction\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Predicted\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Actual\")\n",
        "plt.xticks([0, 1], [\"No Diabetes\", \"Diabetes\"])\n",
        "plt.yticks([0, 1], [\"No Diabetes\", \"Diabetes\"])\n",
        "\n",
        "for i in range(2):\n",
        "    for j in range(2):\n",
        "        plt.text(j, i, cm[i, j], ha=\"center\", va=\"center\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.colorbar()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# Step 10: Feature Importance\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "importance = pd.Series(\n",
        "    model.feature_importances_,\n",
        "    index=X.columns\n",
        ").sort_values(ascending=False)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nFeature Importance:\")\n",
        "print(importance)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(9, 5))\n",
        "importance.plot(kind=\"bar\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Feature Importance in Diabetes Prediction\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Medical Features\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Importance\")\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=45)\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# Step 11: Test with a sample patient\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "sample_patient = np.array([[\n",
        "    2,       # Pregnancies\n",
        "    120,     # Glucose\n",
        "    70,      # BloodPressure\n",
        "    25,      # SkinThickness\n",
        "    80,      # Insulin\n",
        "    28.5,    # BMI\n",
        "    0.25,    # DiabetesPedigreeFunction\n",
        "    30       # Age\n",
        "]])\n",
        "\n",
        "prediction = model.predict(sample_patient)\n",
        "probability = model.predict_proba(sample_patient)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nSample Patient Prediction:\")\n",
        "\n",
        "if prediction[0] == 1:\n",
        "    print(\"Prediction: Diabetes\")\n",
        "else:\n",
        "    print(\"Prediction: No Diabetes\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\n",
        "    f\"Probability of No Diabetes: {probability[0][0] * 100:.2f}%\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "print(\n",
        "    f\"Probability of Diabetes: {probability[0][1] * 100:.2f}%\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
